[Durable owner authorization record](https://github.com/AjaneeI/agentic-analytics-lab/blob/688f62dcedb3116e8ae46579cea0fd135eba94ce/docs/jit-off-v1-one-attempt-authorization-2026-10-18.md). Effective request settings, model/digest and schema/count must pass. No experimental outcome is claimed here.

The one-shot outer launcher consumes an exclusive durable launch.json before its single subprocess invocation. The unchanged collector enforces one worker entry and exclusive fixed output directory. Count1 alone is not a global consumption ledger. Any failure is terminal for this authorization; record missing scores as absent, never zero. A successful tool return can show this attempt avoided timeout, not universal resolution or isolated JIT causation. Frozen task_success plus complete collection/valid postflight/exactly1worker define the existing qualification gate. Phase3 evaluator acceptance and Phase4 freeze remain separate.

This remains a draft; no automatic review or merge is requested. Terminal evidence will be preserved separately after exactly one attempt.
